questions: Does Pines capture actual family household adoption rather than merely advertise family-capable space?
Do East Lake/Subang Avenue have contrary whole-household offers, and does Pines also have shared accommodation?
Do identifiable net rent/price/works differences reverse the capital preference?
rivals: Renovation and parking rather than durable family preference
Price and lower capital burden favour income controls
Good service reputation without funded reserves
preregistered_before_search.scope: 1268-sf Pines R315; 1021-sf Subang Avenue R342; 1093-sf East Lake R350. Neighbourhood and layout substitutes only as controls, not new coverage.
preregistered_before_search.stop: Bounded public offers, institutional context and governance search plus cash/exit/repair thresholds; do not substitute more portal counts for authenticated leases, renewals or MC accounts.
preregistered_before_search.unchanged: No Core/SOP/map/historical input edits; no rent growth or family/management premium assumed.

historical_cases.name: Mont Kiara Pines
historical_cases.evidence_dates: 30 September 2026 sale index; 10 September same-size rental index
historical_cases.source_note: 1268-sf3BR/one-bay sale700k and rent3800 are dated asking/index leads. Furnishing/floor not normalised. Nearby1260-sf3200 and renovated high asks are contrary observations; base3800 is not a lease.
historical_cases.mechanism: Older useful family space can compete with a newer premium one-bedroom at lower capital cost; renovation and major works may consume the apparent income advantage.
historical_cases.buyer: Family tenancy/ownership plus income-led resale are plausible, not measured. Compare OOAK compact, other mature Mont Kiara family stock and newly delivered Allevia by task.
historical_cases.project: Historical age and unverified praise of management cannot settle liabilities. Primary MRT3 evidence does not support current Sri Hartamas rail access shown in portal copy.
historical_cases.comp: A visible1292-sf700k April2026 transaction differs from1268sf; mixed19-record median is not a reference interval.
historical_cases.reversal: At3200rent or higher charges the income lead weakens. A fully renovated premium rent cannot be combined with the cheapest unrefurbished purchase.
historical_cases.next: Identify actual sale condition and fit-out/works budget, confirm matched ordinary3800leases and fees, normalise family transfers and test realistic school/work journeys.
historical_cases.hold: Exact offer, approved plan, rent/costs and normalised clearing value unverified
